arguments.command:
python -c "
import glom
from glom import Auto, Fill, Iter, Let, ROOT, Invoke, Coalesce, Check, Assign, constants

print('=== R2: Public API ===')
print('Auto:', Auto)
print('Fill:', Fill)
print('Iter:', Iter)
print('Let:', Let)
print('ROOT:', ROOT)

print('\n=== R3: Invoke and constants ===')
print('Invoke:', Invoke)
print('constants:', constants)
print('constants.consts:', hasattr(constants, 'consts'))

print('\n=== R4: Fill repr ===')
f = Fill(spec='x', fill_value=1)
print(repr(f))

print('\n=== R5: Assign repr ===')
a = Assign(path='a.b', val=1)
print(repr(a))

print('\n=== R6: Coalesce repr ===')
c = Coalesce('a', 'b')
print(repr(c))

print('\n=== R7: Check repr ===')
ck = Check(type=int)
print(repr(ck))

print('\n=== All specifiers have __repr__ ===')
specifiers = [Auto, Fill, Iter, Let, Invoke, Coalesce, Check, Assign]
for s in specifiers:
    print(f'{s.__name__}: {hasattr(s, \"__repr__\")}')
"
